label: b29: hist8, lr 2.5e-4->0 and clip 0.2->0.001 annealed over the whole 100M, gamma/lambda/entropy fixed, seed 7 of 8, 100M
notes: Batch b29: b28's hist8 config at 100M with the anneal moved from the horizon to the optimiser: SNEK_PPO_LEARNING_RATE_FINAL 0 and SNEK_PPO_CLIP_FINAL 0.001 ramp linearly from step 0 to the 100M cap (SNEK_PPO_ANNEAL_FRACTION 1.0), the PPO paper's Atari schedule. Discount 0.99, GAE lambda 0.95 and entropy coef 0.01 are held at b28's starting values for the whole run (no _FINAL). The clip floor is 0.001 rather than the requested 0 because build_config refuses a clip of exactly 0 (no update admitted); the lr reaches 0 at the same step so the last update is a no-op either way. Reference: b27's hist8 cell (100M, anneal fraction 0.5). Everything else b28: hist 8, step penalty 0.01, epochs 4, mb 512, T 256, huber, adv norm, grad 0.5, adam eps 1e-7, vf 0.5, target_kl 0, chase-safe 0.1 gate 75, fc 320, 128 lanes, seeds 1-8 pinned to the arm letter. Queued 2026-09-10; runs before b30 (priority 300 vs 310).
